note: All 55 trophies are single-player and offline. No online play is required for any of them.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is nothing to do for it directly. Treat it as the finish line: follow the roadmap in this app, clear the story first, then work the 100% checklist and the cleanup stages. Expect a long run — most of the time goes to the 100% completion gold.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and see it through to the end. It is the first mission of the game, so this is the first trophy most players earn. Nothing to prepare — just follow the on-screen objectives.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Story trophies unlock naturally as you play, so keep moving through the chapter missions in order. While you are in Chapter 1, meditate at any spot you come across — that feeds the Positive Mental Attitude trophy, the one spot other guides flag as possibly missable.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. As with the other chapter trophies, it unlocks automatically at the end of the chapter. Use the chapter to try side activities as they appear — they count toward Master of None and the 100% checklist later.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. By now the map is opening up, so between missions grab nearby collectibles and try any new activity type you have not tried yet. The chapter trophy itself needs no special action beyond completing the missions.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the finale. After this chapter, free roam stays open, so anything you have not finished can still be done — the story trophies themselves are already banked by then.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. It is a gold trophy and the natural end of the story arc. Before you start it, save the game in a spare slot if you want a clean point to return to — there is no mission replay, so a manual save is your only way back to the pre-finale world.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the mission flow. It unlocks automatically on completion, like the other named-mission trophies. No side requirement — just finish the mission.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions tend to be longer and multi-stage, so stock up on ammo and armour before you start. The trophy pops when the mission's final objective is done.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It is a story milestone, so it unlocks on completion with no extra steps. If you are tracking the story trophies, this is one of the named missions between the chapter milestones.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Follow the mission markers and finish every objective; the trophy is awarded at mission completion. Keep a manual save before big story missions — there is no mission replay.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. It is a story unlock, so finishing the mission is the whole requirement. The airport area matters again later for the Catch Me If You Can trophy.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Like the other named-mission trophies it unlocks automatically when the mission ends. Treat it as a story checkpoint on the road to the final mission.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion, tracked in the game's own Progress and Stats screens — open them after the story to see exactly what is left. The checklist is the long grind of the platinum: story, stunts, activities, collectibles and exploration all feed it. Work it after the finale in free roam, a few categories at a time, and tick each one off in this app as you go.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near misses, airtime and the like all count toward the tally. The counter builds up naturally if you drive fast and take ramps whenever you see them, so do not grind it in one sitting. Check the in-game stats to see your running total, and fold stunt attempts into travel between missions.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types at least once — fishing, racing, shooting range, bowling, arcade, drone racing and the rest of the map's pastimes. This is a sampler trophy: one taste of each is enough. If you are unsure which types you have tried, the game's activity menu and this app's activity guides are your checklist.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit every range you find and work through its challenges one weapon at a time. Gold thresholds are tight, so learn each challenge's scoring, use the steadiest weapon for the job, and repeat a challenge until the gold medal lands — failed attempts cost nothing but time.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location is its own race, so you must win at every one, not just 14 races anywhere. Learn each course's gates and shortcuts, and retry a location until the win registers. Drone races are quick, so they make a good palate cleanser between bigger goals.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — the word different matters, so the same race twice does not count twice. Enter races across the map in different vehicles and districts until 20 distinct ones are won. Street races, circuit races and off-road events all count toward the set.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take on Cal in a fishing challenge and beat him. Fishing challenges reward patience and the right spot, so watch the bite timing and do not rush the reel. You can retry the challenge if you lose, so treat a loss as practice and go again.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Find an arcade cabinet and finish one full arcade game. Pick the game you find easiest and play it through to its end screen — starting one is not enough, you must complete it. Arcades are scattered around Vice City, so this pairs well with a night out exploring.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Work through Andy's mission strand until his final mission, then complete it. Stranger missions appear as you explore, so check the map for Andy's marker whenever you are nearby. Finishing a character's strand also counts toward the 8 strands needed for Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Work through Kenton's mission strand until his final mission, then complete it. Kenton's strand is one of the character finales, so keep answering his calls and following his markers. Each finale you finish is one more strand toward the Strangers & Freaks silver.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Work through Billy's mission strand until his final mission, then complete it. Billy's missions unlock as you progress and explore, so revisit his marker when it appears. Like the other character finales, it feeds the 8-strand Strangers & Freaks trophy.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions are marked on the map as you explore, and each strand ends with a finale for that character — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret are six of them. There are more strands than the 8 needed, so you can skip any strand you dislike and still reach the total.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Work through Randy's mission strand until his final mission, then complete it. Randy's strand is one of the stranger finales, so follow his markers as they appear on the map. Finishing it counts as one of the 8 strands for the Strangers & Freaks silver.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Work through Tyrone's mission strand until his final mission, then complete it. Tyrone's finale is another strand toward the 8 needed for Strangers & Freaks. If his marker is not showing, keep playing the story and exploring — stranger strands unlock over time.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. This is the one trophy other guides flag as possibly missable: at least one meditation spot appears early, in Chapter 1 with Lucia, so meditate at every spot the moment you find one and never walk past a prompt. If a spot is tied to a story moment, do it then — there is no mission replay. After the story, sweep the map for any spots you missed.
trophies.missableWhy: Possibly missable: an early meditation spot appears in Chapter 1 and there is no mission replay, so meditate at every spot as soon as you find it.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take on Bret's hunt and bring down the unique animal he asks for. Hunts need tracking and patience: follow the signs, move quietly, and take the shot only when it is clean. This is one of Bret's strand missions, so it also moves you toward the 8 stranger strands.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida, so pick up every card you spot while exploring and keep a mental note of which sets are close to complete. Finish the sets with the fewest cards missing first, then hunt the stragglers — the trophy pops when the third set is complete.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different locations across Leonida. This is a pure exploration grind: visit new places and trigger WAiNK at each one. Pair it with the Goodtime State exploration — as you cover all 52 areas, WAiNK at every stop and the count will climb on its own.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges of any kind. Challenges are the game's small side goals — driving, combat, exploration and activity feats — and they stack up over normal play. Check the challenges menu to see which ones you are close to, then chase the easy ones first to reach 50.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside you, build up a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Partner activities need the two of you together, so set this up deliberately: cause trouble in a quiet area, then break line of sight and hide until the stars clear. It is a one-shot setup you can retry in free roam, so do not worry if the first attempt fails.
trophies.missableWhy: One-shot partner feat: it needs your partner beside you at 4 stars, so set it up deliberately rather than hoping it happens by accident.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without the wanted level dropping between them. Plan a route of three close-together shops, hit them fast, and keep moving — the trick is speed, not firepower. If the wanted level clears, the chain breaks and you start the count again, so retry until the run is clean.
trophies.missableWhy: One-shot partner feat: three robberies back-to-back with no break in the wanted level, so plan the route first and run it in one go.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — drive or ride anything new you see and it counts. Variety is the point: cars, bikes, boats and aircraft all add to the tally. Explore different districts and vehicle spawns, and hop into anything you have not driven before.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: In one single use of Combat Focus, take down 5 enemies. Set it up where enemies cluster: enter a fight with a full focus meter, trigger it, and chain the kills fast. If you run out of targets, the attempt ends — retry in a busy shootout until 5 fall inside one focus window.
trophies.missableWhy: One-shot combat feat: all 5 takedowns must land inside a single Combat Focus, so set it up where enemies cluster.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, make an unscheduled departure — leave the airport in a way the schedule never planned. Think outside the terminal: grab a plane or a fast vehicle and get airborne or out of the grounds without following the normal route. Expect a wanted level, so plan your exit before you start.
trophies.missableWhy: One-shot feat at the airport: it needs a deliberate unscheduled exit from VCIA, so plan it rather than stumbling into it.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: This one is about the Rhino tanks — get involved with them and survive the heat. When tanks show up at high wanted levels, deal with them head-on or slip away once the moment registers. It is a combat set-piece trophy, so a high wanted level in an open area is the way to invite it.
trophies.missableWhy: One-shot combat moment tied to Rhino tanks at high wanted levels, so set it up deliberately in open ground.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at all. Go in quiet: plan the entry, avoid cameras and sightlines, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails — back out, reset, and try a stealthier approach.
trophies.missableWhy: One-shot stealth feat: a single detection fails the attempt, so plan the entry and go in quiet.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank vaults are the big heists of the open world: plan the approach, crack the vault, grab the cash and get clear of the wanted level before it counts. Do them one at a time across the map — all 5 must end in a clean escape.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks patrol the roads, so watch for one, stop it, crack it open and take the cash — then lose the wanted level that follows. A quiet stretch of road and a fast getaway car make the escape far easier.
trophies.missableWhy: One-shot feat: the robbery and the escape must both succeed in one run, so plan the getaway before you stop the truck.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The in-game map tracks which areas you have visited, so sweep it district by district and drive into every corner you have not seen. Pair this with the WAiNK and vehicle-discovery trophies — one long road trip can advance all three at once.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang runs its own operations around Leonida, so you need one hit per gang — not nine hits on the same gang. Learn which turf belongs to whom, hit one operation in each territory, and escape after each one.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy it with the view. This is a pure vibe trophy — no combat, no timer. Find a beachfront bar, sit down with a drink, and let the moment register. Do it at sunset for the full effect.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive straight through the glass and out onto the street. Pick a showroom, pick a fast car inside it, and floor it through the front. Expect a wanted level and a broken showroom, so have a getaway ready.
trophies.missableWhy: One-shot feat: the smash-out has to happen in a single run through the showroom glass, so pick the car and the line before you floor it.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through on a game — play a full game and see it to the end. Bowling is one of the 9 activity types, so this also counts toward Master of None. Take your time with the aim; the trophy is about finishing, not a perfect score.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: This is a partnership trophy — do something with your partner that the public notices. Partner activities and shared moments are the key, so spend time doing things together around Leonida and the trophy will come. If it has not popped, try a different shared activity in a busy, public place.
trophies.missableWhy: Partner-gated: it needs a shared moment with your partner in public, so set it up together rather than playing solo.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make choices — and live with them. This trophy is about decisions, not combat: the choices you make across the story and side content shape your path, and some of them are permanent. Play naturally and the trophy will come as your choices add up; do not try to game it, and keep manual saves before big decisions if you want to see both sides.
trophies.missableWhy: Choice-gated: some choices are permanent, so think before you commit and keep a manual save before big decisions.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try. This one is about persistence: fail at something, then come back and nail it the second time. It rewards the retry, so if a challenge beats you once, do not give up — go straight back in and finish it.
trophies.missableWhy: Retry-gated: it needs a success on a second attempt, so a failed first try is part of the path, not a problem.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the kind of odd, unscripted moment Leonida throws at you when you are not expecting it. Keep your eyes open while exploring, especially in out-of-the-way places and at odd hours. You cannot force it, so explore widely and it will find you.
trophies.missableWhy: Easy to walk past: it needs a rare, strange moment in the world, so explore out-of-the-way places and stay alert.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — strike from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon. Line up a slow pass, swing as you go by, and keep moving. It is a one-shot stunt, so pick a quiet street with a clear target and try until the hit lands.
trophies.missableWhy: One-shot feat: the melee hit has to land from a moving vehicle in a single pass, so set up a slow, clear run.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from heists and robberies, and your contacts turn them into clean cash — the total is cumulative, so every laundered dollar counts. Keep laundering as you earn, and the quarter-million will arrive on its own.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, food, cars, anything you buy counts toward the total. The spend is cumulative, so normal play builds it steadily. If you are close to the total late in the game, top it up with a big purchase you actually want, like a vehicle or a weapon.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties around Leonida. Garage properties are bought with in-game money, so save up and purchase them as you find them — each one also gives you somewhere to store vehicles. Check the property listings on the map and buy the remaining ones once your funds allow.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Whenever you find a vehicle you like, open the app and register it — each new registration counts. Ten different vehicles are needed, so register as you discover them rather than saving it all for the end.
trophies.name: On the Spot
